A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide an estimator for dynamic panel estimation that is suitable for short panels.
the proposed Bayesian estimator is robust to cross-sectional dependence, dynamic heterogeneity and short panel data, and it is easy to implement.
the Bayesian approach is a powerful and flexible tool for dynamic panel estimation, and that the cross-sectional dependence is a crucial feature to be accounted for.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ignoring cross-sectional dependence and/or dynamic heterogeneity in dynamic panel data models is likely to lead to misleading conclusions.
the cross-sectional dimension of the data is crucial to the analysis, and that it must be taken into account in any empirical work on panel data.
the cross-sectional dependence in panel VAR models is likely to be large and that ignoring it leads to misleading results.
